summary: Master value for money assessment in project management. Join our course to improve your decision-making and ensure successful project delivery.
lede: Value for money assessment in project management is a structured way to compare project options using costs, benefits, risks and outcomes. It is intended for project, business-case, finance and portfolio professionals who support investment decisions. Learners practise appraising options, modelling whole-life costs and financial measures, mapping benefits to owners, and testing uncertainty to develop an evidence-based recommendation.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who contribute to project investment decisions, business cases, benefits tracking, financial evaluation, procurement, or portfolio governance. It is appropriate for foundation-to-intermediate learners who need a practical assessment process and do not require programming experience.
prerequisites: You should have basic exposure to project objectives, schedules, budgets, risks, and governance meetings. The course uses spreadsheet-based calculations and structured templates, but coding is not required. Advanced concepts such as probabilistic forecasting and AI-assisted analysis receive conceptual or operational treatment rather than technical engineering instruction.
